description: Get a pre-publish checklist for a specific UI type. Returns actionable yes/no items to verify before shipping.

platform.description: Platform context for platform-specific checks. 'ios' = native SwiftUI/iOS (Apple HIG); 'react-native' = RN/Expo (iOS HIG + Android Material: 44/48pt+hitSlop, accessibilityLabel/Role, font scaling, SafeAreaView, dark mode, platform parity, secrets). Both replace the web/mobile-web checks.

type.description: What you're shipping (e.g. 'signup form', 'pricing page', 'dashboard', 'landing page', 'modal')

name: get_checklist
